description:
Key Features:

- Three-bedroom semi-detached family home
- Spacious front living room with large box bay window
- Gas fireplace with attractive wood panelling surround
- Modern dining kitchen with wall and base units
- Separate utility room with plumbing for washing machine
- Built-in ground floor store room with external access
- Fitted wardrobes/storage to all three bedrooms
- Family bathroom with shower cubicle and white suite
- Enclosed rear garden with lawn and shed
- Detached garage
- Convenient location close to Nottingham University, QMC and excellent transport links
- Ideal first-time buy, family home or investment opportunity

Property Description

Situated in the popular and well-connected area of Dunkirk, this well-presented three-bedroom home offers spacious accommodation throughout and is ideally positioned for a range of local amenities, transport links and major employers including the Queen's Medical Centre and the University of Nottingham.

The accommodation begins with a small entrance hall which leads into a welcoming front living room. This bright and comfortable reception space benefits from a large box bay window allowing plenty of natural light to flood the room, along with fitted carpets and an attractive gas fireplace set within a feature wooden panelled surround, creating a cosy focal point.

To the rear of the property is a dining kitchen fitted with a range of wall and base units, providing ample storage and worktop space. The room is complemented by laminate flooring and offers plenty of space for dining and entertaining. A door leads directly out to the rear garden, while a useful built-in store room provides additional storage with rear external access. Leading from the kitchen is a separate utility room with plumbing for a washing machine and further practical space for household appliances.

To the first floor, the landing gives access to three bedrooms. The generous principal bedroom overlooks the front elevation and benefits from a large window together with built-in wardrobes and storage. The second bedroom is a good-sized double room with views over the rear garden and also features built-in storage. The third bedroom enjoys a rear-facing window and fitted sliding wardrobes.

Completing the accommodation is the family bathroom, fitted with a shower cubicle, wash hand basin and WC, all presented in a classic white suite.

Externally, the property enjoys an enclosed rear garden with fenced boundaries, a lawned area and a garden shed, providing an excellent outdoor space for families and entertaining. A garage offers valuable storage.

Location

Ednaston Road enjoys a convenient position within the sought-after Dunkirk area of Nottingham. The property is ideally placed for easy access to the University of Nottingham, Queen's Medical Centre and Nottingham City Centre. A wide range of local shops, supermarkets, schools, parks and leisure facilities are available nearby, while excellent public transport links and road connections, including the A52 and M1 motorway network, make commuting straightforward. The nearby Wollaton Park and Nottingham city centre offer an array of recreational, shopping and dining opportunities, making this an attractive location for a variety of purchasers.

Viewing is highly recommended to appreciate the accommodation and convenient location on offer.
